Revolt SFXThe Perfect Small Form Factor Power SupplyThe Phanteks Revolt SFX 850W is ready for the most powerful next-gen hardware in a super-compact SFX footprint. It was built according to the new Intel ATX 3.0 platform specifications and comes with native PCIe Gen5 12v-2×6 (12VHPWR) support out of the box. The high efficiency, 80 PLUS Platinum certification guarantees 92% efficiency at 50% system load.
The Revolt SFX 850W power supply comes with customized cables that are tailored for small form factor chassis, especially when paired with the Phanteks Evolv Shift XT chassis. A built-in silent 92 mm Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) fan with intelligent thermal control optimizes noise and cooling performance. It also features a 0 RPM mode while under 30% load for ultimate silence.

textSegments: The Perfect Small Form Factor Power Supply

The Phanteks Revolt SFX 850W is ready for the most powerful next-gen hardware in a super-compact SFX footprint. It was built according to the new Intel ATX 3.0 platform specifications and comes with native PCIe Gen5 12v-2×6 (12VHPWR) support out of the box. The high efficiency, 80 PLUS Platinum certification guarantees 92% efficiency at 50% system load.

The Revolt SFX 850W power supply comes with customized cables that are tailored for small form factor chassis, especially when paired with the Phanteks Evolv Shift XT chassis. A built-in silent 92 mm Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) fan with intelligent thermal control optimizes noise and cooling performance. It also features a 0 RPM mode while under 30% load for ultimate silence.
Next gen SFX12V 4.0 platform matching the ATX 3.0 requirements.
Native 12VHPWR port from the power supply.
Supports up to 600 Watts to the GPU.
Super flexible 12VHPWR flat ribbon cable for tight cable routing.
Tailored For Small Form Factor Chassis
Customized cable length to reduce excess cables.
Super flexible single-lane flat ribbon cables.
Compact SFX form-factor to free up space.
Perfect match for the Evolv Shift XT chassis.
Intelligent thermal control to optimize noise and cooling performance.
Complete silence with 0 RPM mode under 30% load in Hybrid Mode.
Long lasting 92mm Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) fan.
Highly efficiënt, 80PLUS Platinum certified with 94% efficiency at 50% load.
Ultimate Silence With Hybrid Fan Control
Activate the 0 RPM mode with the Hybrid Fan button on the rear to go for absolute silence when under low load. The REVOLT SFX will control the fan speed intelligently based on load and temperature.

Where do I find the product manual?

Most products have their product manual in the accessory box or directly printed on the packaging if the installation only contains a few steps. For the latest version, we always recommend checking the online manual, which can be found under the support section of the product page.
How do I know my GPU will fit?
How do I know my GPU will fit?

Because there are many different GPU sizes, it is always recommended to check the GPU clearance beforehand. If the length of the GPU fits within the clearance numbers, the GPU should fit neatly. This information can be found within the ‘Specifications’ section on the product page.
